ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

H,W=SRC.shape[:2]
Y,X=np.mgrid[:H,:W].astype(np.float32)

def smooth(a):

    if a.ndim==2:return map_coordinates(a,[yy,xx],order=order,mode='constant',cval=0,prefilter=False)

        wall[y,540:790,k]=np.polyval(coef,(np.arange(540,790)-670)/160)

ell=np.sqrt(((X-cx)/76.5)**2+((Y-cy)/79.0)**2)

ball_support[(X>746)&(Y<136)]=0
ball_support[Y<84]=0

# optically soft tennis fuzz and the original seam intact.
balpha=np.clip((wall[...,0]-SRC[...,0])/(wall[...,0]-27+1e-5),0,1)
balpha=np.maximum(balpha,smooth((.94-ell)/.12)) * ball_support
balpha[balpha<.007]=0
bcol=np.clip((SRC-wall*(1-balpha[...,None]))/np.maximum(balpha[...,None],.006),0,255)
# Isolate each jaw by the wall/foreground discontinuity.
leftregion=(X>546)&(X<675)&(Y<168)
rightregion=(X>=675)&(X<790)&(Y<134)
